title: Factory Core hybrid topology extension
problem: Factory Core v1.1.0 converts every declared capability into an agent, even when software, a workflow, a data store, a service, decision support, or a human approval gate is the safer and more efficient mechanism.
outcome: Factory A0 can compile explicit hybrid topologies while preserving legacy requests and zero standing external authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Hybrid requests require an explicit component type for every capability.
Only components declared as agent appear in the manifest agents collection.
Software, workflow, decision-support, data-store, service, and human-gate identities are preserved.
Exactly one orchestrator and at least one independent assurance component are required.
Handoffs reference known components, are typed, reachable from the orchestrator, and acyclic.
Legacy agent-team requests retain their existing behavior.
The generic synthetic runner fails closed on hybrid manifests.
All Factory Core, A0, and reserved Run 013 tests pass with zero external actions and zero spend.
